summary: Add standalone Blockscout and bounded public RPC deployment with optional Nginx
details: Provide an independent usdb-public CLI and versioned release kit, connecting explicit upstream RPC endpoints without a node installation or controller dependency.
Require network identity, canonical checkpoint, historical state and tracing samples across configured upstreams; compare explorer results with a fixed checkpoint and optional independent reference.
Support external Nginx routing or a bundled ingress with existing HTTPS certificates and checked reload; derive frontend and wallet URLs from one advertised origin.
Gate RPC by chain/genesis identity, reject privileged and node-signing methods, validate entire batches before forwarding, and bound request sizes, concurrency, rates and log ranges.
Hide unqualified Ethereum reward and burnt-fee assumptions in the explorer API and UI while preserving actual transaction fees and receipt values.
Preserve deployment credentials and database identity across backed-up configuration replacements; public up/down never operates upstream nodes.

Mark the pinned public-registry images as private compatibility preview inputs; actual archive replay, maintained-image qualification, contract verification, public TLS and wallet acceptance remain outstanding.
Keep a generic external-memory reservation on nodes for optional colocation; independently publish the public gateway by digest and the standalone kit using usdb-public-vX.Y.Z tags.

Generate a release-bound one-line installer with an embedded archive SHA-256, verified immutable version directories and an atomic CLI activation; preserve existing operator configuration and deployment data.
operator_actions: Run the selected public-service release installer, then edit its default private configuration to select qualified historical/tracing/broadcast endpoints.
Choose external or bundled ingress, run preflight and check, and retain private deployment configuration plus consistent database backups.
Current locked images remain private-preview inputs; complete maintained-image and public-network qualification before exposure.
